t: A fast, cheap Cortex-M4 chip that outguns the classic STM32F103.
steps: Buy a WeAct Studio AT32F403A Black Pill from AliExpress or a maker shop such as Electropi.
Add the WeAct AT32F4 board package using its link in the board manager settings.
Pick the AT32F403A board and its port from the menus.
Open the Blink example and press Upload.
Try PlatformIO with the official Artery platform once you want the full firmware library.
